issues.description: Method SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery: the problem statement's UML declares the method as public (+acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int)) (problem_statement.md line 30), but the solution implementation declares it with package-private visibility (no access modifier) as 'static void acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity)' in src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java line 47. The problem statement also requires the method to be static (problem_statement.md lines 78-81) but the UML's '+' implies it should be part of the public API. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected access modifier (public vs package-private) when they implement the method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Either change the method signature in SealSaloon to 'public static void acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity)' so it matches the UML/public API in the problem statement, or update the problem statement/UML to indicate the method is package-private if that was intended. Prefer making it public static to match the UML and avoid ambiguity for students.
